summary: First test iteration for EHS RAG app — all 16 backend pytest tests PASS and all critical frontend flows PASS. Verified: health, login (admin), register (new normal user, not first-superadmin promoted), /auth/me, admin/stats RBAC (superadmin 200 / non-superadmin 403), seeded base_corpus (7 docs / 9+ chunks, all processed), document upload + processing poll (<30s), company-priority boost (uploaded doc with UNIQUE_TOKEN_XYZ_LOCKOUT was returned as a source for matching query), reprocess on seeded doc, full chat flow (single message → 8 sources & confidence 0.73, session continuation produces 4+ messages with alternating user/assistant roles, session listing, session deletion), web-source full CRUD + scrape (example.com returned chunks_stored>=1, no 500). Frontend (1920x1080): Login page renders brand panel + register link + demo credentials; admin/stats shows all six stat tiles + Knowledge Source Priority + Document-Type Chunking Strategy; admin/documents lists docs and opens the Upload dialog; admin/web-sources opens Add URL dialog; chat shows 5 suggestion buttons, sends message via suggestion, renders assistant markdown response with confidence badge and 7 source cards in the right sources-panel (xl breakpoint); New Chat clears the conversation; Logout returns to /login.

minor.issue: Endpoint returns 200 immediately but the background reprocess for the 'Chemical Safety — GHS/SDS/Hazard Communication' base_corpus doc ended in ERROR state (chunk_count=0, status=ERROR badge in UI) after the test ran. Likely an embedding/parsing failure during reprocess; document is left with processing_error set and zero chunks until manually re-uploaded. Not a blocking bug — listing & GET still work — but ideally reprocess should be transactional (keep previous chunks if new embedding fails).

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration error: <button data-testid="delete-session-{id}"> is nested inside the parent <button data-testid="session-{id}">. Console error: 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>. This will cause a hydration error.' Functionality still works because of event handlers, but this is invalid HTML and produces a noisy console error on every chat page load.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description — accessibility warning in console (low priority)

action_items: Fix nested <button> inside <button> in ChatPage.jsx session row — wrap the row in a div or convert the outer to a div + onClick (avoid nested buttons). This fixes the hydration error logged on /chat.

Optional: make /api/documents/{id}/reprocess transactional — only replace chunks after the new embedding pipeline succeeds; on failure, keep the existing chunks and only set processing_error. Otherwise a failed reprocess leaves a previously-working seeded doc in an unusable state.
Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Upload Document and Add Web Source DialogContents to clear the Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Nested interactive elements in ChatPage session list — invalid HTML semantics and accessibility issue.
Reprocess endpoint is not atomic — it can leave seeded documents in an ERROR / zero-chunk state.
All routes are properly /api-prefixed and use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — good.
Mongo _id is properly excluded from API responses across documents, chat sessions, web-sources — good.
First-user-becomes-superadmin logic confirmed: registering a brand new user after seed correctly produced role!=superadmin — good.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows pass; 1 console hydration error from nested buttons)

seed_data_creation: Tests create a transient user newuser+<ts>@example.com (kept; non-superadmin), one TXT document 'TEST SOP LOTO XYZ' (deleted by fixture), one Web Source for https://www.example.com (deleted by fixture), and chat sessions (some deleted, one continuation session may remain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_ehs_rag_api.py covers full happy-path. After the reprocess test runs, the seeded 'Chemical Safety - GHS, SDS, Hazard Communication' base_corpus document may be left in an ERROR state with 0 chunks — to fully reset, re-run /app/backend/seed.py or POST /api/documents/{id}/reprocess again on that doc. The chat sources panel only renders at viewport width >=1280px (Tailwind xl). All chat responses are non-streaming via POST /api/chat/. The /api/chat/stream endpoint is intentionally not implemented.
rca of the issue: ChatPage hydration error RCA: in ChatPage.jsx lines ~173–189 the recent-sessions list renders a <button> for each session with onClick={selectSession}, and inside that button a second <button data-testid=delete-session-{id}> is rendered for hover-delete. React/HTML disallow nested buttons, so React emits a hydration error in the console on every chat page load. Reproduction: open /chat with any existing session in the sidebar — error fires immediately. Mitigation: change the outer <button> to a <div role="button" tabIndex=0 onClick=...> (or place the delete control outside the session button, e.g. absolutely positioned over the row), so the delete <button> is no longer a descendant of an interactive <button>.
